channel.title: Tim Cook | Marco Troisi
channel.description: Marco Troisi is a founder, fractional CTO and software architect. Through O2A Labs he helps founders make sound technical decisions and build software that serves the business.

item.title: Apple and the battle for privacy
item.description: TL;DR: Apple is in no position for attacking other companies over how they deal with their users privacy and security. There is nothing in their policies that makes us think they care about us more than other companies do. Only a few weeks ago, Apple’s CEO Tim Cook delivered a speech on privacy, …
